P: Serve the soup when the Reverend's soup kitchen opens.
S: Soup kitchen cheddar and onion rolls
the Reverend's shelter, ready for dunking into the stew

Soft pull-apart rolls baked with sharp cheddar and caramelised onion, brushed with butter and served warm. Fry 1 sliced onion in 20g butter for 15 minutes until golden. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 300ml warm milk and 30g melted butter, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour. Knead in the onion and 100g grated cheddar, shape 12 rolls and pack into a tin. Rise 30 minutes, top with 50g more cheddar and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Rounds of pizza dough topped with tomato and mozzarella, a crosshatch of pepperoni strips for the grate, baked at 230C for 8 minutes.
Crumbed dill pickle chips with ranch
sour from the barrel, downtown on the Lower East Side

Sliced dill pickles crumbed in panko and fried crisp, with cool garlic and herb ranch for dipping. Slice 4 large dill pickles into 5mm rounds and pat very dry. Toss in 50g plain flour, dip in 1 beaten egg, then coat in 80g panko. Fry at 180C in batches for 2 minutes until golden, then drain. Mix 100g sour cream, 50g mayonnaise, 1 crushed garlic clove, chopped chives and dill, and a squeeze of lemon for the ranch.
M: Beef chuck browned, braised with onion, carrot, celery, tomato paste and stock for 2.5 hours, potatoes for the last hour. Crusty bread.
the all-night counter where Captain Bosch's men eat
Three-egg omelettes folded around ham, green capsicum and onion, with paprika home fries and rye toast.
W: Soft apple cider cake doughnuts tossed in cinnamon sugar. Reduce 500ml apple juice to 125ml.
K: Lime cordial with tonic water, which glows under a black light.

dishes.make_ahead: Best the day they are baked

steps.text: Fry the onion in some of the butter until golden.
Mix the flour, yeast, salt, sugar, warm milk and the rest of the melted butter. Knead.
Rise in a covered bowl until doubled.
Knead in the onion and most of the cheddar. Shape 12 rolls and pack into a tin.
Rise again.
Top with the remaining cheddar and bake at 200C.

dishes.make_ahead: Dice the ham, capsicum and onion and par-boil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 12 minutes, cool a little and cut into chunks.
Fry the potatoes in the oil with the paprika and half the salt until crisp, about 12 minutes, for the home fries.
Soften the capsicum and onion in a little of the butter, then add the ham and warm through.
For each omelette, beat 3 eggs with a pinch of salt, cook in butter until just set, fill with a quarter of the ham mix and fold.
Repeat for the other three and serve with the home fries and rye toast.

s.n: Soup kitchen cheddar and onion rolls
s.note: Soft pull-apart rolls baked with sharp cheddar and caramelised onion, brushed with butter and served warm.
s.how: Fry 1 sliced onion in 20g butter for 15 minutes until golden. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar, 300ml warm milk and 30g melted butter, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour. Knead in the onion and 100g grated cheddar, shape 12 rolls and pack into a tin. Rise 30 minutes, top with 50g more cheddar and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

Roll 500g pizza dough thin and cut 12 rounds. Spread with pizza sauce, using 150ml, and top with 150g grated mozzarella. Slice 80g pepperoni into thin strips and lay them in a crosshatch like a manhole grate. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 2 chopped brown onions, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook 5 minutes, then 1 litre beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours, adding 600g potatoes in chunks for the last hour. Serve with a loaf of Italian bread.

w.how: Reduce 500ml apple juice to 125ml. Mix with 60g melted butter, 1 egg, 100g sugar and 250g self-raising flour into a soft dough. Pat out, cut 12 rings and fry at 175C for 2 minutes a side. Toss in sugar and cinnamon.

d.how: Pour 40ml lime cordial into each of four tall glasses over ice and top with tonic water, about 250ml each. Tonic glows blue-white under a black light, so switch the lights off.
